decisions.reason: Because the app extends the firm's airport service offering and any weak uptake can still be blamed on the temporary collapse in air travel, management is likely to persist despite only moderate visible commitment.

The firm publicly launched and named this passenger-processing technology, signaling higher investment and reputational commitment, which under escalation of commitment makes management inclined to continue with it while aviation demand recovers.

This self-service check-in solution fits the firm's stated innovation path and airport client base, so management is likely to retain it, though overlap with related offerings creates some chance of later rationalization.
